aggregate.speed_effect: none: none of these PRs is a speedup on this workload

prs.title: fp32 token-scaling factors for low-precision grad buffers
prs.check_time: one 4-step check (time per check not recorded)
prs.measured_effect: installed but not reached: witness 0 on all 3 `scale_gradients`; loss within 4.4e-5 of base
prs.note: bf16 buffers on this workload never call the changed code.

prs.title: cache `get_start_time_from_progress_log`
prs.measured_effect: installed but not reached: witness 0 (start-up-only code); loss within 1.5e-4
prs.note: Kind inferred from the title; no speed effect was measured.

prs.measured_effect: runs, no regression: loss within 1.0e-3, grad norm within 2.6e-3 of base
prs.note: Via the zygote this PR took 148.7 s once (first fork, slow warm-up, unexplained).
